```{r libraries}
# Molecular subtype — matches fig4/fig5/fig6 subtype_cols; Blood keyed to tissue blood

  "Nonlesional"  = "#AAAAAA",
```

# Load & Prepare Malignant CTCL T Cells

```{r load_data}
ctcl <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")

# ── Subtype assignment from fig4 consensus clustering (k=4, S1 and S2) ────────
subtype_df_fig4 <- readRDS("../fig4/results/subtype_df.rds") %>%
  mutate(orig.merge = sub("__[^_]+$", "", sample))

s1_samples    <- subtype_df_fig4$orig.merge[subtype_df_fig4$subtype == "Subtype_1"]
s2_samples    <- subtype_df_fig4$orig.merge[subtype_df_fig4$subtype == "Subtype_2"]
blood_samples <- subtype_df_fig4$orig.merge[subtype_df_fig4$subtype == "Subtype_3"]

# Any orig.merge that is blood tissue gets forced to Blood, even if misclustered as S1/S2
blood_origs   <- unique(ctcl$orig.merge[tolower(ctcl$Tissue) == "blood"])
s1_samples    <- setdiff(s1_samples, blood_origs)
s2_samples    <- setdiff(s2_samples, blood_origs)
blood_samples <- union(blood_samples, blood_origs)

ctcl$subtype.ctcl <- case_when(
  ctcl$orig.merge %in% s1_samples    ~ "Subtype_1",
  ctcl$orig.merge %in% s2_samples    ~ "Subtype_2",
  ctcl$orig.merge %in% blood_samples ~ "Blood",
  TRUE                               ~ "ND"
)
ctcl$subtype.ctcl <- factor(ctcl$subtype.ctcl,
                             levels = c("ND", "Blood", "Subtype_1", "Subtype_2"))

ctcl$CTCL_Phenotype <- case_when(
  ctcl$malig.pheno %in% c("CD4", "DNT") ~ "CD4",
  ctcl$malig.pheno == "CD8"             ~ "CD8",
  ctcl$malig.pheno == "GDT"             ~ "GDT",
  TRUE                                  ~ "ND"
)

cat("Samples — Subtype_1:", length(unique(ctcl$orig.merge[ctcl$subtype.ctcl == "Subtype_1"])),
    "| Subtype_2:", length(unique(ctcl$orig.merge[ctcl$subtype.ctcl == "Subtype_2"])), "\n")
cat("Cohorts:", length(unique(ctcl$GEO.Cohort)), "\n")
table(ctcl$CTCL_Phenotype)
```

# Panel A — Pseudobulk logCPM Heatmap (CTCL Cells per Sample)

```{r pseudobulk_logcpm}
ctcl_malig <- subset(ctcl, celltype.malig == "CTCL")

pb <- AggregateExpression(
  ctcl_malig,
  group.by      = "orig.merge",
  assays        = "RNA",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

# malignant CTCL cells contributing to each pseudobulk sample
ncell_malig <- table(ctcl_malig$orig.merge)

dge    <- DGEList(counts = pb)
dge    <- calcNormFactors(dge)
# prior.count = 3 damps low-count marker noise (FOXP3, AIRE, IL2RA, ...)
logcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 3)

# Drop unreliable small pseudobulks (< MIN_CELLS malignant cells). This filters
# `logcpm`, which flows into `sample_meta` (via the Panel A column intersect) and
# therefore into every downstream panel that reads `sample_meta`. `pb` (raw
# counts) is left intact for the panels that rebuild their own DGEList.
MIN_CELLS    <- 10
keep_display <- names(ncell_malig)[ncell_malig >= MIN_CELLS]
logcpm       <- logcpm[, colnames(logcpm) %in% keep_display, drop = FALSE]

cat("Pseudobulk matrix:", nrow(logcpm), "genes x", ncol(logcpm), "samples",
    "(dropped", sum(ncell_malig < MIN_CELLS), "samples with <", MIN_CELLS, "cells)\n")
```

```{r gene_groups}
gene_groups <- list(
  "Lineage"      = c("PTPRC", "CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G", "CD4", "FOXP3", "CD8A", "CD8B", "TRDC", "CD2", "CD5"),
  "Diagnosis"    = c("CD7", "DPP4", "TOX", "GATA3", "PLS3", "AIRE", "CD164", "CADM1"),
  "Targets"      = c("CCR4", "TNFRSF8", "IL2RA", "CD52", "KIR3DL2"),
  "Homing"       = c("CCR7", "SELL", "CCR10", "CD69", "ITGAE"),
  "Checkpoints"  = c("PDCD1", "CD274", "CTLA4", "LAG3", "TIGIT"),
  "HLA Class I"  = c("HLA-A", "HLA-B", "HLA-C"),
  "HLA Class II" = c("HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-DRB5", "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DQB1",
                     "HLA-DPA1", "HLA-DPB1")
)

genes_ordered <- lapply(gene_groups, function(g) intersect(g, rownames(logcpm)))
genes_ordered <- genes_ordered[sapply(genes_ordered, length) > 0]

gene_vec <- unlist(genes_ordered)
gap_rows <- cumsum(sapply(genes_ordered, length))
gap_rows <- gap_rows[-length(gap_rows)]

mat <- logcpm[gene_vec, , drop = FALSE]

cat("Genes in heatmap:", length(gene_vec), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", setdiff(unlist(gene_groups), rownames(logcpm)), "\n")
```

```{r sample_metadata}
sample_meta <- ctcl_malig@meta.data %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(orig.merge, Tissue, CTCL_Phenotype, subtype.ctcl, Sample.Type.simple, GEO.Cohort) %>%
  remove_rownames() %>%
  column_to_rownames("orig.merge")

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(mat), rownames(sample_meta))
mat            <- mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta    <- sample_meta[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

tissue_order  <- c("blood", "lymph node", "skin")
pheno_order   <- c("GDT", "CD8", "CD4")
subtype_order <- c("ND", "Blood", "Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")
stype_order   <- c("Blood", "lymph node", "Nonlesional", "Patch_Plaque", "Tumor", "Erythroderma")

sample_meta <- sample_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Sample.Type.simple = ifelse(is.na(Sample.Type.simple), Tissue, Sample.Type.simple),
    Tissue             = factor(Tissue,             levels = tissue_order),
    CTCL_Phenotype     = factor(CTCL_Phenotype,     levels = pheno_order),
    subtype.ctcl       = factor(subtype.ctcl,       levels = subtype_order),
    Sample.Type.simple = factor(Sample.Type.simple, levels = stype_order)
  )

base_order  <- order(sample_meta$Tissue, sample_meta$CTCL_Phenotype,
                     sample_meta$subtype.ctcl, sample_meta$Sample.Type.simple)
mat         <- mat[, base_order, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta <- sample_meta[base_order, , drop = FALSE]

# Hierarchical clustering within each Tissue × CTCL_Phenotype × subtype.ctcl × Sample.Type.simple group
group_key <- paste(sample_meta$Tissue, sample_meta$CTCL_Phenotype,
                   sample_meta$subtype.ctcl, sample_meta$Sample.Type.simple, sep = "___")

clustered_order <- unlist(lapply(unique(group_key), function(grp) {
  idx <- which(group_key == grp)
  if (length(idx) <= 2) return(idx)
  sub_mat <- mat[, idx, drop = FALSE]
  d  <- dist(t(sub_mat), method = "euclidean")
  hc <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
  idx[hc$order]
}))

mat         <- mat[, clustered_order, drop = FALSE]
sample_meta <- sample_meta[clustered_order, , drop = FALSE]

# cells per pseudobulk (aligned by sample name, survives reordering)
sample_meta$ncells <- as.integer(ncell_malig[rownames(sample_meta)])

# Column gaps at tissue and phenotype boundaries
tissue_int <- as.integer(sample_meta$Tissue)
pheno_int  <- as.integer(sample_meta$CTCL_Phenotype)
gaps_col   <- sort(unique(c(which(diff(tissue_int) != 0), which(diff(pheno_int) != 0))))

cat("Samples per tissue:\n")
print(table(sample_meta$Tissue))
cat("Samples per phenotype:\n")
print(table(sample_meta$CTCL_Phenotype))
cat("Samples per subtype:\n")
print(table(sample_meta$subtype.ctcl))
```

```{r heatmap_plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
ann_col <- data.frame(
  nCells_log10       = log10(sample_meta$ncells),   # renamed below (closest to heatmap)
  Tissue             = sample_meta$Tissue,
  CTCL_Phenotype     = sample_meta$CTCL_Phenotype,
  subtype.ctcl       = sample_meta$subtype.ctcl,

)
colnames(ann_col)[1] <- "log10(nCells)"

ann_col$subtype.ctcl[ann_col$Tissue == "blood"] <- "Blood"

ann_colors <- list(
  `log10(nCells)`    = c("#F7FBFF", "#08306B"),   # scaled blue, light -> dark
  Tissue             = tissue_cols,

)

mat_vals  <- as.numeric(mat)
cap_hi    <- quantile(mat_vals, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
cap_lo    <- max(0, quantile(mat_vals, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE))

pheatmap(
  mat,
  color             = heat_cols,
  breaks            = heat_breaks,
  annotation_col    = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  gaps_col          = gaps_col,

  scale             = "none",
  show_colnames     = FALSE,
  fontsize_row      = 9,

)

pdf("figs/ctcl_pseudobulk_logcpm_heatmap.pdf", width = 18, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
pheatmap(
  mat,
  color             = heat_cols,
  breaks            = heat_breaks,
  annotation_col    = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  gaps_col          = gaps_col,
  gaps_row          = gap_rows,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_cols      = FALSE,
  scale             = "none",
  show_colnames     = FALSE,
  fontsize_row      = 9,
  border_color      = NA,
  main              = "Malignant CTCL Cells — Pseudobulk logCPM by Sample"
)
dev.off()
```

# Panel B — Gene-Gene Correlation Heatmap (CD4 skin + blood, dream residuals)

```{r dream_setup}
# ── CD4 samples, skin + blood only (drop lymph node) ─────────────────────────
#    Samples come from sample_meta, so the Panel A ncell filter (>= MIN_CELLS)
#    already applies; voom/dream need counts, so rebuild the DGE from `pb`.
samples_cor <- rownames(sample_meta)[
  sample_meta$CTCL_Phenotype == "CD4" & sample_meta$Tissue != "lymph node"
]
meta_cor <- droplevels(sample_meta[samples_cor, , drop = FALSE])

cat("CD4 samples (skin + blood):", nrow(meta_cor), "\n")
cat("Tissue breakdown:\n"); print(table(meta_cor$Tissue))

dge_cor <- DGEList(counts = pb[, samples_cor, drop = FALSE])
dge_cor <- calcNormFactors(dge_cor)
keep_cor <- filterByExpr(dge_cor, min.count = 5) | rownames(dge_cor) %in% gene_vec
dge_cor  <- dge_cor[keep_cor, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat("Genes retained for voom/dream:", nrow(dge_cor), "\n")
cat("Panel genes retained:", sum(gene_vec %in% rownames(dge_cor)), "/", length(gene_vec), "\n")
```

```{r dream_fit}
# ── voom + dream: remove tissue (fixed) + cohort (random), keep intrinsic signal
form_resid <- ~ Tissue + (1 | GEO.Cohort)
vobj_resid <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge_cor, form_resid, meta_cor, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)
fit_resid  <- dream(vobj_resid, form_resid, meta_cor, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)

# ── Residuals for the panel genes (tissue + cohort removed) ───────────────────
panel_genes <- intersect(setdiff(gene_vec, c("TRDC", "CD8A", "CD8B")), rownames(fit_resid))
resid_mat   <- residuals(fit_resid)[panel_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# drop any gene with zero residual variance (else cor() -> NA rows, which breaks
# the correlation-distance clustering below)
keep_var    <- apply(resid_mat, 1, sd) > 0
resid_mat   <- resid_mat[keep_var, , drop = FALSE]
panel_genes <- rownames(resid_mat)

# ── Gene functional-group annotation ─────────────────────────────────────────
gene_group_map <- stack(lapply(genes_ordered, function(g) intersect(g, rownames(logcpm))))
gene_group_map <- setNames(as.character(gene_group_map$ind), gene_group_map$values)
group_labels   <- gene_group_map[panel_genes]

n_groups  <- length(unique(group_labels))
group_pal <- setNames(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(n_groups, 3), "Set2")[seq_len(n_groups)],
  unique(group_labels)
)
```

```{r panel_b_heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
# ── Gene-gene Spearman r on dream residuals (CD4 skin + blood; tissue + cohort removed)
cor_mat  <- cor(t(resid_mat), method = "spearman")
ann_gene <- data.frame(Group = group_labels, row.names = panel_genes)

# cluster on correlation distance so co-varying genes group together
cor_dist <- as.dist(1 - cor_mat)

cor_heatmap_args <- list(
  cor_mat,
  color                    = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(100),
  breaks                   = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  annotation_row           = ann_gene,
  annotation_col           = ann_gene,
  annotation_colors        = list(Group = group_pal),
  cluster_rows             = TRUE,
  cluster_cols             = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = cor_dist,
  clustering_distance_cols = cor_dist,
  clustering_method        = "ward.D2",
  show_rownames            = TRUE,
  show_colnames            = FALSE,
  fontsize_row             = 8,
  border_color             = NA,
  main                     = "Gene–Gene Spearman r — CD4 skin + blood (tissue + cohort removed)"
)

do.call(pheatmap, cor_heatmap_args)

pdf("figs/gene_gene_cor_dream_residuals.pdf", width = 9, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
do.call(pheatmap, cor_heatmap_args)
dev.off()
```

# Panels C–D — CD4 Trajectory DEG (lesion, subtype, subtype-reversed)

```{r traj_setup}
# ── Patient ID per sample (adds the (1|Patient.ID) term, matching fig4/fig6) ──
patient_lookup <- ctcl_malig@meta.data %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, Patient.ID)
patient_lookup <- setNames(as.character(patient_lookup$Patient.ID),
                           patient_lookup$orig.merge)

# ── Base CD4 skin + blood metadata (inherits the Panel A ncell filter) ────────
traj_base <- sample_meta %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  filter(CTCL_Phenotype == "CD4", Tissue %in% c("skin", "blood")) %>%
  mutate(Patient.ID = patient_lookup[sample_id])

# ── Three ordinal trajectory encodings ───────────────────────────────────────
#    `prog(m)` returns the ordinal stage (1..3) per row; rows returning NA are
#    dropped, so each ordering selects its own sample set.
traj_specs <- list(
  lesion = list(
    title  = "CD4 Disease Trajectory (Early CTCL → Late CTCL → Blood)",
    labels = c("1" = "Early CTCL", "2" = "Late CTCL", "3" = "Blood"),
    prog   = function(m) unname(c(Nonlesional = 1, Patch_Plaque = 1, Tumor = 2,
                                  Erythroderma = 2, Blood = 3)[as.character(m$Sample.Type.simple)])
  ),
  subtype = list(
    title  = "CD4 Subtype Trajectory (Subtype_1 → Subtype_2 → Blood)",
    labels = c("1" = "Subtype_1", "2" = "Subtype_2", "3" = "Blood"),
    prog   = function(m) dplyr::case_when(
      m$Tissue == "skin"  & m$subtype.ctcl == "Subtype_1" ~ 1,
      m$Tissue == "skin"  & m$subtype.ctcl == "Subtype_2" ~ 2,
      m$Tissue == "blood"                                 ~ 3
    )
  ),
  subtype_rev = list(
    title  = "CD4 Subtype Trajectory — Reversed (Subtype_2 → Subtype_1 → Blood)",
    labels = c("1" = "Subtype_2", "2" = "Subtype_1", "3" = "Blood"),
    prog   = function(m) dplyr::case_when(
      m$Tissue == "skin"  & m$subtype.ctcl == "Subtype_2" ~ 1,
      m$Tissue == "skin"  & m$subtype.ctcl == "Subtype_1" ~ 2,
      m$Tissue == "blood"                                 ~ 3
    )
  )
)
```

```{r traj_deg}
tcr_pat <- "^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC"

run_traj_dream <- function(spec) {
  m <- traj_base
  m$progression <- spec$prog(m)
  m <- m %>%
    filter(!is.na(progression)) %>%
    mutate(
      GEO.Cohort = factor(GEO.Cohort),
      Patient.ID = factor(Patient.ID),
      stage      = factor(spec$labels[as.character(progression)], levels = spec$labels)
    )

  # ── DGE from shared pseudobulk counts; drop low-expressed + TCR/Ig genes ────
  dge  <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(counts = pb[, m$sample_id, drop = FALSE]))
  keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = factor(m$progression), min.count = 5, min.prop = 0.2)
  dge  <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge  <- dge[!grepl(tcr_pat, rownames(dge)), , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

  # ── Cohort + patient as random effects, added only when each has structure ──
  use_cohort  <- n_distinct(m$GEO.Cohort) >= 2
  use_patient <- any(duplicated(m$Patient.ID))
  form <- if (use_cohort && use_patient) ~ progression + (1 | GEO.Cohort) + (1 | Patient.ID)
          else if (use_cohort)           ~ progression + (1 | GEO.Cohort)
          else if (use_patient)          ~ progression + (1 | Patient.ID)
          else                           ~ progression

  vobj <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, m, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)
  fit  <- eBayes(dream(vobj, form, m, BPPARAM = BPPARAM))
  deg  <- topTable(fit, coef = "progression", number = Inf) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>% arrange(P.Value)

  list(meta = m, form = form,
       logcpm = cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 3), deg = deg)
}

traj_res <- lapply(traj_specs, run_traj_dream)

# back-compatible names for the downstream comparison section
deg_traj     <- traj_res$lesion$deg
deg_sub_traj <- traj_res$subtype$deg
deg_sub_rev  <- traj_res$subtype_rev$deg

for (nm in names(traj_res)) {
  cat("\n=====", traj_specs[[nm]]$title, "=====\n")
  cat("model:", deparse(traj_res[[nm]]$form), "\n")
  cat("samples per stage:\n"); print(table(traj_res[[nm]]$meta$stage))
  cat("FDR < 0.05:", sum(traj_res[[nm]]$deg$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
}

saveRDS(deg_traj,     "results/deg_traj.rds")
saveRDS(deg_sub_traj, "results/deg_sub_traj.rds")
saveRDS(deg_sub_rev,  "results/deg_sub_rev.rds")
```

```{r traj_lollipop, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
# ── Lollipop of the top 10 up + top 10 down genes — LESION trajectory ─────────
n_top <- 15
deg_traj <- readRDS("results/deg_traj.rds")
deg_sub_traj <- readRDS("results/deg_sub_traj.rds")
deg_sub_rev <- readRDS("results/deg_sub_rev.rds")

top_lolli <- bind_rows(
  deg_traj %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0) %>%
    slice_max(logFC, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE),
  deg_traj %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < 0) %>%
    slice_min(logFC, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE)
) %>%
  mutate(gene     = factor(gene, levels = gene[order(logFC)]),
         neg_logp = -log10(adj.P.Val))

lfc_lim <- max(abs(top_lolli$logFC))

p_traj_lolli <- ggplot(top_lolli, aes(x = logFC, y = gene, color = logFC)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = logFC, y = gene, yend = gene),
               linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(size = neg_logp)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lfc_lim, lfc_lim),
                        oob = scales::squish, name = expression(log[2]~FC)) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = expression(-log[10]~FDR), range = c(1, 5)) +
  labs(x = expression("log2FC (per step)"), y = NULL,
       title = "Stage-based Trajectory") +
  theme_fig

print(p_traj_lolli)
ggsave("figs/cd4_trajectory_lollipop.pdf", plot = p_traj_lolli,
       width = 4.5, height = 6.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
```

```{r traj_ribbons, fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
# ── Ribbon trajectories for selected genes — LESION trajectory ────────────────
# Source expression + staging from the canonical pseudobulk objects (`logcpm`,
# `traj_base`), staging samples with the shared lesion prog function so the
# ribbon uses exactly the same samples/encoding as the lesion DEG.
meta_les <- traj_base %>%
  mutate(progression = traj_specs$lesion$prog(traj_base)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(progression), sample_id %in% colnames(logcpm))

stage_plot_labels <- c("1" = "Patch/Plaque", "2" = "Tumor/Ery", "3" = "Blood")
gene_cols <- c("#B2182B", "#2166AC", "#4DAF4A")

make_traj_ribbon <- function(genes) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(logcpm))
  df <- as.data.frame(t(logcpm[genes, meta_les$sample_id, drop = FALSE])) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
    left_join(meta_les %>% select(sample_id, progression), by = "sample_id") %>%
    mutate(stage = factor(stage_plot_labels[as.character(progression)],
                          levels = stage_plot_labels),
           gene  = factor(gene, levels = genes))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = stage, y = logCPM, color = gene, fill = gene, group = gene)) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "ribbon", alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line",  linewidth = 0.9) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(gene_cols[seq_along(genes)], genes), name = "Gene") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = setNames(gene_cols[seq_along(genes)], genes), name = "Gene") +
    labs(x = "Disease stage", y = "Mean logCPM ± 95% CI") +
    theme_fig + theme(legend.position = "right")
}

p_up   <- make_traj_ribbon(c("AIRE", "KLF2", "SELL")) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
p_down <- make_traj_ribbon(c("GZMB", "CSF2", "CCL4"))

p_traj_ribbons <- p_up / p_down
print(p_traj_ribbons)

ggsave("figs/cd4_trajectory_ribbon_selected.pdf", plot = p_traj_ribbons,
       width = 4, height = 5.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
```

```{r traj_tvalue_correlation, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=5}
# ── Join t-values and significance flags for disease vs subtype (S1→S2→Blood) ──
t_joined <- deg_traj %>%
  select(gene, t_disease = t, sig_disease = adj.P.Val) %>%
  inner_join(
    deg_sub_traj %>% select(gene, t_subtype = t, sig_subtype = adj.P.Val),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      sig_disease < 0.05 & sig_subtype < 0.05 ~ "Both",
      sig_disease < 0.05 & sig_subtype >= 0.05 ~ "Lesion only",
      sig_disease >= 0.05 & sig_subtype < 0.05 ~ "Subtype only",
      TRUE                                      ~ "ns"
    ),
    category = factor(category, levels = c("Both", "Lesion only", "Subtype only", "ns"))
  )

rho <- cor(t_joined$t_disease, t_joined$t_subtype, method = "spearman")
cat(sprintf("Genes compared: %d\nSpearman ρ — Disease vs. Subtype (S1→S2→Blood): %.3f\n",
            nrow(t_joined), rho))
print(table(t_joined$category))

cat_cols <- c("Both" = "#7B1B2E", "Lesion only" = "#F77F00",
              "Subtype only" = "#4393C3", "ns" = "grey80")

# plot ns first so sig points render on top
t_plot <- t_joined %>% arrange(category == "ns", category)

p_t_scatter <- ggplot(t_plot, aes(x = t_disease, y = t_subtype, color = category)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0) +

  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label = sprintf("ρ = %.3f", rho),

  labs(
    title = "",
    x     = "t (Stage-based encoding)",
    y     = "t (Subtype-based encoding)"
  ) +
  theme_fig +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
```

# Validation — Independent Bulk Cohort (GSE168508)

```{r surv_load}
library(scales)

mat_indep  <- readRDS("../../int/surv.mat.rds")
meta_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.meta.ss.rds")

# Log-normalize
logcpm_indep <- edgeR::cpm(mat_indep, log = TRUE)

# Filter: keep genes expressed (logCPM > 1) in at least 10% of samples
keep_indep   <- rowSums(logcpm_indep > 1) >= ceiling(0.10 * ncol(logcpm_indep))
logcpm_indep <- logcpm_indep[keep_indep, ]

meta_indep$lct <- factor(meta_indep$lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT"))

cat("Independent dataset:", nrow(logcpm_indep), "genes x", ncol(logcpm_indep), "samples\n")
cat("LCT status:\n"); print(table(meta_indep$lct))
```

```{r surv_score_build}
# ── Load skin S1 vs S2 DEG results (positive logFC = Subtype_1 high) ──────────
deg_s1s2 <- readRDS("../fig4/results/res_skin_subtypes.rds")

n_sig <- 25

genes_s1 <- deg_s1s2 %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0) %>%
  slice_max(t, n = n_sig) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  intersect(rownames(logcpm_indep))

genes_s2 <- deg_s1s2 %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < 0) %>%
  slice_min(t, n = n_sig) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  intersect(rownames(logcpm_indep))

cat("Subtype_1 signature genes in dataset:", length(genes_s1), "\n")
cat("Subtype_2 signature genes in dataset:", length(genes_s2), "\n")

# ── Score each sample as mean logCPM of signature genes ───────────────────────
score_df <- data.frame(
  sample     = colnames(logcpm_indep),
  score_s1   = colMeans(logcpm_indep[genes_s1, , drop = FALSE]),
  score_s2   = colMeans(logcpm_indep[genes_s2, , drop = FALSE]),
  lct        = meta_indep[colnames(logcpm_indep), "lct"]
)
```


```{r surv_score_violin, fig.width=3, fig.height=6}
score_long <- score_df %>%
  pivot_longer(c(score_s1, score_s2),
               names_to  = "signature",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(
    signature = factor(
      ifelse(signature == "score_s1", "Subtype_1", "Subtype_2"),
      levels = c("Subtype_1", "Subtype_2")
    )
  )

lct_cols  <- c("NLCT" = "#4393C3", "LCT" = "#B2182B")
sig_cols  <- c("Subtype_1" = "#B2182B", "Subtype_2" = "#2166AC")

# ── Wilcoxon p-values ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pval_s1 <- wilcox.test(score_s1 ~ lct, data = score_df)$p.value
pval_s2 <- wilcox.test(score_s2 ~ lct, data = score_df)$p.value
cat(sprintf("Wilcoxon p — Subtype_1 score (NLCT vs LCT): %.4f\n", pval_s1))
cat(sprintf("Wilcoxon p — Subtype_2 score (NLCT vs LCT): %.4f\n", pval_s2))

make_violin <- function(scores, lct_vec, title, ylab) {
  df <- data.frame(score = scores, lct = lct_vec)
  pval <- wilcox.test(score ~ lct, data = df)$p.value
  ggplot(df, aes(x = lct, y = score, fill = lct)) +
    geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7, color = NA) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "grey30") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6, color = "grey20") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = Inf,
             label = sprintf("p = %.3f", pval),
             vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = lct_cols) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_fig +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

p_v1 <- make_violin(score_df$score_s1, score_df$lct,
                    "Subtype 1 Signature",
                    paste0("Mean logCPM (top ", n_sig, " genes)"))
p_v2 <- make_violin(score_df$score_s2, score_df$lct,
                    "Subtype 2 Signature",
                    paste0("Mean logCPM (top ", n_sig, " genes)"))

p_surv_violin <- p_v1 | p_v2
print(p_surv_violin)

ggsave("figs/surv_subtype_signature_lct_violin.pdf", plot = p_surv_violin,
       width = 5.5, height = 3, useDingbats = FALSE)
```

```{r lct_deg, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
library(limma)

# ── DEG: NLCT vs LCT (LCT = reference; positive logFC = NLCT high) ────────────
meta_lct <- meta_indep[colnames(logcpm_indep), ] %>%
  mutate(lct = relevel(factor(lct), ref = "LCT"))

design_lct <- model.matrix(~ lct, data = meta_lct)

fit_lct  <- lmFit(logcpm_indep, design_lct)
fit_lct  <- eBayes(fit_lct)
deg_lct  <- topTable(fit_lct, coef = "lctNLCT", number = Inf) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  arrange(P.Value)

cat("NLCT vs LCT — FDR < 0.05:", sum(deg_lct$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")

deg_lct %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0) %>%
  select(gene, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>% head(5) %>% print()
cat("\nTop LCT-high (negative logFC):\n")
deg_lct %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < 0) %>%
  select(gene, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>% head(5) %>% print()

saveRDS(deg_lct, "results/deg_lct.rds")
# ── Merge with S1 vs S2 skin DEG (pos logFC = Subtype_1 high) ─────────────────
t_merged <- deg_lct %>%
  select(gene, t_lct = t, sig_lct = adj.P.Val) %>%
  inner_join(
    deg_s1s2 %>% select(gene, t_subtype = t, sig_subtype = adj.P.Val),
    by = "gene"

  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      sig_lct < 0.05 & sig_subtype < 0.05 ~ "Both",
      sig_lct < 0.05 & sig_subtype >= 0.05 ~ "LCT only",
      sig_lct >= 0.05 & sig_subtype < 0.05 ~ "Subtype only",
      TRUE                                  ~ "ns"
    ),
    category = factor(category, levels = c("Both", "LCT only", "Subtype only", "ns"))
  )

rho_lct <- cor(t_merged$t_lct, t_merged$t_subtype, method = "spearman")
cat(sprintf("\nGenes compared: %d\nSpearman ρ — LCT vs Subtype: %.3f\n",
            nrow(t_merged), rho_lct))
print(table(t_merged$category))

cat_cols_lct <- c("Both" = "#7B1B2E", "LCT only" = "#F77F00",
                  "Subtype only" = "#4393C3", "ns" = "grey80")

# label genes at the extremes of each axis + both diagonals, restricted to
# genes significant in at least one contrast (deduped)
lab_lct <- t_merged %>%
  filter(category != "ns") %>%
  mutate(s = t_lct + t_subtype, d = t_lct - t_subtype)
lab_lct <- bind_rows(
  slice_max(lab_lct, t_lct,     n = 6), slice_min(lab_lct, t_lct,     n = 6),
  slice_max(lab_lct, t_subtype, n = 6), slice_min(lab_lct, t_subtype, n = 6),
  slice_max(lab_lct, s,         n = 4), slice_min(lab_lct, s,         n = 4),
  slice_max(lab_lct, d,         n = 4), slice_min(lab_lct, d,         n = 4)
) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

p_lct_scatter <- ggplot(t_merged %>% arrange(category == "ns", category),

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black") +
```

```{r surv_km, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(broom)

# ── Merge scores with survival data ───────────────────────────────────────────
surv_df <- score_df %>%
  left_join(
    meta_indep %>%
      select(pfs_time, pfs_event, os_time, os_event) %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample"),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group_S1   = ifelse(score_s1 >= mean(score_s1), "S1_High", "S1_Low"),
    Group_S2   = ifelse(score_s2 >= mean(score_s2), "S2_High", "S2_Low"),
    score_diff = score_s1 - score_s2,
    Group_Diff = ifelse(score_diff >= mean(score_diff), "Subtype_1_Like", "Subtype_2_Like"),
    Group_S1   = factor(Group_S1,   levels = c("S1_High", "S1_Low")),
    Group_S2   = factor(Group_S2,   levels = c("S2_High", "S2_Low")),
    Group_Diff = factor(Group_Diff, levels = c("Subtype_1_Like", "Subtype_2_Like"))
  )

km_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "top",
    legend.title       = element_blank(),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# ── Helper: tidy survfit → ggplot2 KM ─────────────────────────────────────────
logrank_p <- function(formula, data) {
  sd <- survdiff(formula, data = data)
  pchisq(sd$chisq, df = length(sd$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

tidy_km <- function(fit) {
  broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    mutate(strata = sub("^[^=]+=", "", strata))   # strip "Group_XX=" prefix
}

make_km <- function(formula, data, title, col_map) {
  fit  <- survfit(formula, data = data)
  pval <- logrank_p(formula, data)
  td   <- tidy_km(fit)

  ggplot(td, aes(x = time, y = estimate, color = strata)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = td %>% filter(n.censor > 0),
               aes(x = time, y = estimate, color = strata),
               shape = 3, size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = col_map) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf,
             label = sprintf("p = %s", signif(pval, 2)),
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.2) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Time (months)", y = "Survival probability") +
    km_theme
}

# ── Color maps (keyed to stripped strata labels) ───────────────────────────────
cm_s1   <- c("S1_High" = "#B2182B", "S1_Low" = "grey65")
cm_s2   <- c("S2_High" = "#2166AC", "S2_Low" = "grey65")
cm_diff <- c("Subtype_1_Like" = "#B2182B", "Subtype_2_Like" = "#2166AC")

# ── Build all 6 panels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_pfs_s1   <- make_km(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ Group_S1,   surv_df, "PFS: Subtype 1 Score", cm_s1)
p_pfs_s2   <- make_km(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ Group_S2,   surv_df, "PFS: Subtype 2 Score", cm_s2)
p_pfs_diff <- make_km(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ Group_Diff, surv_df, "PFS: S1 vs S2",        cm_diff)
p_os_s1    <- make_km(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ Group_S1,   surv_df, "OS: Subtype 1 Score",  cm_s1)
p_os_s2    <- make_km(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ Group_S2,   surv_df, "OS: Subtype 2 Score",  cm_s2)
p_os_diff  <- make_km(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ Group_Diff, surv_df, "OS: S1 vs S2",         cm_diff)

p_km_grid <- (p_pfs_s1 | p_pfs_s2 | p_pfs_diff) /
  (p_os_s1  | p_os_s2  | p_os_diff)

print(p_km_grid)

ggsave("figs/surv_subtype_km_curves.pdf", plot = p_km_grid,
       width = 10, height = 5.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
```

```{r extra_sub_bulk_score}
# ── Whole-sample TME Subtype_1-vs-Subtype_2 bulk DEG (fig6); +logFC = S1 high ──
res_sub_bulk <- readRDS("../fig6/results/res_sub_bulk.rds")

n_top <- 25
# rank within genes present in the independent cohort (top 25 by t each direction)

genes_up <- cand %>% slice_max(t, n = n_top) %>% pull(gene)   # Subtype_1-high

cat("Up (S1) genes:", length(genes_up), "| Down (S2) genes:", length(genes_dn), "\n")

# ── Score each sample as mean logCPM of each set + composite (up - down) ───────
sub_score_df <- data.frame(
  sample   = colnames(logcpm_indep),
  score_up = colMeans(logcpm_indep[genes_up, , drop = FALSE]),
  score_dn = colMeans(logcpm_indep[genes_dn, , drop = FALSE])
) %>%
  mutate(score_comp = score_up - score_dn)   # composite: Subtype_1-like axis
```

```{r surv_cox_continuous}
# ── Continuous Cox models: Subtype-1, Subtype-2, and composite (S1−S2) signature
#    scores as continuous predictors of PFS and OS, each fit UNADJUSTED and
#    ADJUSTED for LCT status. Scores are z-scored, so HR is per 1 SD and directly
#    comparable across signatures and between the unadjusted/+LCT models.
#    Results saved for reporting. Reuses `surv_df` (scores + survival + lct).
library(survival); library(broom)
stopifnot(exists("surv_df"),
          all(c("score_s1", "score_s2", "score_diff", "lct") %in% names(surv_df)))

# composite = the S1-minus-S2 axis already carried in surv_df as score_diff
score_map <- c(score_s1 = "Subtype_1", score_s2 = "Subtype_2",
               score_diff = "Composite (S1-S2)")
specs <- expand.grid(sc = names(score_map), ep = c("PFS", "OS"),
                     model = c("unadjusted", "+LCT"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cox_cont_res <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(specs)), function(i) {
  sc <- specs$sc[i]; ep <- specs$ep[i]; mdl <- specs$model[i]
  d  <- surv_df
  d$x <- as.numeric(scale(d[[sc]]))                    # z-score -> HR per 1 SD
  surv_lhs <- if (ep == "PFS") "Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event)" else "Surv(os_time, os_event)"
  rhs      <- if (mdl == "+LCT") "x + lct" else "x"
  fit <- coxph(as.formula(paste(surv_lhs, "~", rhs)), data = d)
  sm  <- summary(fit)
  tf  <- broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == "x")                         # isolate the score effect
  data.frame(
    score     = unname(score_map[sc]),
    endpoint  = ep,
    model     = mdl,
    n         = sm$n,
    n_events  = sm$nevent,
    HR_per_SD = tf$estimate,
    conf.low  = tf$conf.low,
    conf.high = tf$conf.high,
    z         = tf$statistic,
    p.value   = tf$p.value,
    C_index   = unname(sm$concordance["C"]),           # +LCT rows: joint score+LCT discrimination
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

cox_cont_res <- cox_cont_res %>%
  dplyr::arrange(endpoint, factor(score, levels = unname(score_map)),
                 factor(model, levels = c("unadjusted", "+LCT"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(HR_per_SD, conf.low, conf.high, z, C_index), \(v) round(v, 3)),
                p.value = signif(p.value, 3))

print(cox_cont_res)

write.csv(cox_cont_res, "results/cox_continuous_subtype_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(cox_cont_res,   "results/cox_continuous_subtype_scores.rds")
```

```{r surv_cox, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
# ── 1. Cox regression: subtype scores as continuous predictors ─────────────────
library(broom)

cox_df <- surv_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lct_bin = as.integer(lct == "LCT"))  # LCT=1, NLCT=0

# Fit 4 models for each endpoint: score alone, + lct, + interaction
cox_models <- list(
  pfs_diff        = coxph(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ score_diff,           data = cox_df),
  pfs_diff_lct    = coxph(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ score_diff + lct,     data = cox_df),
  pfs_diff_int    = coxph(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ score_diff * lct,     data = cox_df),
  os_diff         = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ score_diff,           data = cox_df),
  os_diff_lct     = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ score_diff + lct,     data = cox_df),
  os_diff_int     = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ score_diff * lct,     data = cox_df),
  pfs_s1          = coxph(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ score_s1 + lct,       data = cox_df),
  pfs_s2          = coxph(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ score_s2 + lct,       data = cox_df),
  os_s1           = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ score_s1 + lct,       data = cox_df),
  os_s2           = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ score_s2 + lct,       data = cox_df)
)

cox_tidy <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(names(cox_models), function(nm)
    broom::tidy(cox_models[[nm]], exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(model = nm)
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), \(x) round(x, 3)),
                p.value = signif(p.value, 3))

print(cox_tidy)

# ── Forest plot of score_diff models ──────────────────────────────────────────
forest_df <- cox_tidy %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("score_diff$|score_s1$|score_s2$|lctNLCT|lct_bin", term),
                !grepl(":", term)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = paste0(model, ": ", term),
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(unique(label)))
  )

p_forest <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(x = estimate, y = label,
                                   xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high,
                                   color = grepl("int", model))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.25, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#2166AC", "TRUE" = "#B2182B"),
                     labels = c("Main effect", "Interaction model"),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = "Cox regression — subtype scores vs survival") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_forest)
ggsave("figs/surv_cox_forest.pdf", plot = p_forest,
       width = 7, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)
```

```{r surv_score_optimization, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXPLORATORY (nothing saved). Stress-tests the scoring + modeling choices on the
# S1-vs-S2 prognostic signal:
#   (1) scorer:  unweighted mean logCPM [current] vs per-gene z vs |t|-weighted z
#   (2) model:   continuous Cox (per 1 SD) vs mean-split vs median-split log-rank
#   (3) confound: unadjusted vs + LCT
# Leads with the single S1-minus-S2 axis (the cleanest contrast). Reuses objects
# built earlier: logcpm_indep, meta_indep, deg_s1s2, genes_s1, genes_s2, score_df.
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(survival); library(broom)
stopifnot(exists("logcpm_indep"), exists("meta_indep"), exists("deg_s1s2"),
          exists("genes_s1"), exists("genes_s2"), exists("score_df"))

# signed, weighted signature on the shared gene set (S1 = +1, S2 = -1; w = |t|)
opt_sig <- deg_s1s2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% c(genes_s1, genes_s2),
                gene %in% rownames(logcpm_indep)) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene,
                   dir = ifelse(gene %in% genes_s1, 1, -1),
                   w   = abs(t))
cat(sprintf("signature genes used: %d (%d S1 / %d S2)\n",
            nrow(opt_sig), sum(opt_sig$dir > 0), sum(opt_sig$dir < 0)))

X  <- logcpm_indep[opt_sig$gene, , drop = FALSE]   # genes x samples
Xz <- t(scale(t(X)))                               # per-gene z across samples

# three S1-minus-S2 score variants (all oriented so higher = more S1-like)
opt_scores <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(X),
  mean   = score_df$score_s1[match(colnames(X), score_df$sample)] -
           score_df$score_s2[match(colnames(X), score_df$sample)],
  z      = colMeans(opt_sig$dir * Xz),
  tw_z   = as.numeric(crossprod(opt_sig$dir * opt_sig$w, Xz)) / sum(opt_sig$w)
)

opt_surv <- opt_scores %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_indep %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
      dplyr::select(sample, lct, pfs_time, pfs_event, os_time, os_event),
    by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lct = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")))

methods   <- c(mean = "Unweighted mean logCPM (current)",
               z    = "Per-gene z",
               tw_z = "|t|-weighted z")
endpoints <- list(PFS = c("pfs_time", "pfs_event"),
                  OS  = c("os_time", "os_event"))

ep_frame <- function(mc, ep) {
  te <- endpoints[[ep]]
  opt_surv %>%
    dplyr::transmute(time = .data[[te[1]]], event = .data[[te[2]]], lct,
                     score = as.numeric(scale(.data[[mc]]))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(event), !is.na(score))
}

fit_cox <- function(d, adj) {
  form <- if (adj == "+ LCT") Surv(time, event) ~ score + lct else Surv(time, event) ~ score
  f <- coxph(form, data = d)
  broom::tidy(f, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == "score") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(HR = estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p = p.value,
                     c_index = summary(f)$concordance[1], adj = adj)
}

# (1)+(3): continuous Cox, every scorer x endpoint x adjustment
opt_cox <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(methods), function(mc)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(endpoints), function(ep) {
    d <- ep_frame(mc, ep)
    dplyr::bind_rows(fit_cox(d, "unadjusted"), fit_cox(d, "+ LCT")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(method = mc, endpoint = ep)
  }))))

cat("\n=== Continuous Cox (HR per 1 SD of S1-minus-S2 score) ===\n")
opt_cox %>%
  dplyr::transmute(method = unname(methods[method]), endpoint, adj,
                   HR = round(HR, 2),
                   CI = sprintf("%.2f-%.2f", conf.low, conf.high),
                   p = signif(p, 3), c_index = round(c_index, 3)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(endpoint, method, adj) %>% as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

# save continuous Cox (unadjusted + LCT-adjusted) for the supplementary
write.csv(opt_cox, "results/surv_continuous_cox_by_scorer.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# (2): dichotomization cost — continuous p vs mean/median split log-rank (unadjusted)
lr_split <- function(d, fun) {
  g  <- factor(ifelse(d$score >= fun(d$score), "High", "Low"))
  sd <- survdiff(Surv(time, event) ~ g, data = d)
  pchisq(sd$chisq, df = length(sd$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
}
opt_dich <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(methods), function(mc)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(endpoints), function(ep) {
    d <- ep_frame(mc, ep)
    data.frame(method = unname(methods[mc]), endpoint = ep,
               cox_continuous = signif(fit_cox(d, "unadjusted")$p, 3),
               logrank_mean   = signif(lr_split(d, mean), 3),
               logrank_median = signif(lr_split(d, median), 3))
  }))))
cat("\n=== Dichotomization cost: continuous Cox p vs split log-rank p (unadjusted) ===\n")
opt_dich %>% dplyr::arrange(endpoint, method) %>% as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

# figure: forest of continuous-Cox HRs, scorer x adjustment, faceted by endpoint
opt_cox_plot <- opt_cox %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method_lab = factor(unname(methods[method]), levels = rev(methods)),
                adj = factor(adj, levels = c("unadjusted", "+ LCT")),
                endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = c("PFS", "OS")))

ggplot(opt_cox_plot, aes(x = HR, y = method_lab, color = adj)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.55), size = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ endpoint) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("unadjusted" = "#B2182B", "+ LCT" = "#2166AC"),
                     name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "HR per 1 SD of S1-minus-S2 score (log scale)", y = NULL,
       title = "Continuous Cox: subtype score vs outcome by scoring method") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r surv_score_lct_addedvalue, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXPLORATORY (nothing saved). Does the CONTINUOUS subtype score add prognostic
# value ABOVE AND BEYOND the binary LCT label?
#   (1) LRT:           Cox(~ lct) vs Cox(~ lct + score)  -> p for adding the score
#   (2) discrimination: c-index + AIC for LCT-only / score-only / both
#   (3) within-stratum: continuous-score Cox run separately within LCT and NLCT
# Reuses opt_surv, methods, endpoints, ep_frame from the previous chunk.
# score is standardized cohort-wide (per 1 SD) inside ep_frame, so HRs stay
# comparable to the overall analysis even when fit within a stratum.
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(survival)
stopifnot(exists("opt_surv"), exists("ep_frame"),
          exists("methods"), exists("endpoints"))

cstat <- function(f) unname(summary(f)$concordance[1])

# (1)+(2): LCT-only vs score-only vs both, with LRT for adding score to LCT
addval <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(endpoints), function(ep) {
  base  <- ep_frame("mean", ep)                       # lct identical across scorers
  f_lct0 <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ lct, data = base)
  lct_row <- data.frame(endpoint = ep, scorer = "-", model = "LCT only",
                        c_index = cstat(f_lct0), AIC = AIC(f_lct0), lrt_p = NA_real_)
  sc_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(methods), function(mc) {
    d      <- ep_frame(mc, ep)
    f_lct  <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ lct,         data = d)
    f_sc   <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ score,       data = d)
    f_both <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ lct + score, data = d)
    lrt_p  <- pchisq(2 * (f_both$loglik[2] - f_lct$loglik[2]),
                     df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)      # adding score to LCT
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      data.frame(endpoint = ep, scorer = unname(methods[mc]), model = "score only",
                 c_index = cstat(f_sc),   AIC = AIC(f_sc),   lrt_p = NA_real_),
      data.frame(endpoint = ep, scorer = unname(methods[mc]), model = "LCT + score",
                 c_index = cstat(f_both), AIC = AIC(f_both), lrt_p = lrt_p)
    )
  }))
  dplyr::bind_rows(lct_row, sc_rows)
}))

cat("=== Added value of continuous score over binary LCT ===\n")
cat("LRT p = test of adding the score to an LCT-only model; lower AIC = better fit\n\n")
addval %>%
  dplyr::transmute(endpoint, scorer, model,
                   c_index = round(c_index, 3), AIC = round(AIC, 1),
                   lrt_p = ifelse(is.na(lrt_p), "-", as.character(signif(lrt_p, 3)))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(endpoint, scorer, model) %>% as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

# save LCT added-value (LCT-only / score-only / both: c-index, AIC, LRT) for the supplementary
write.csv(addval, "results/surv_lct_addedvalue.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# (3): within-stratum continuous-score Cox (per scorer x endpoint x LCT stratum)
within_strat <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(methods), function(mc)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(endpoints), function(ep) {
    d <- ep_frame(mc, ep)
    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c("LCT", "NLCT"), function(grp) {
      ds <- dplyr::filter(d, lct == grp)
      if (nrow(ds) < 5 || sum(ds$event) < 3)
        return(data.frame(scorer = unname(methods[mc]), endpoint = ep, stratum = grp,
                          n = nrow(ds), events = sum(ds$event),
                          HR = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_,
                          p = NA_real_))
      s <- summary(coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ score, data = ds))
      data.frame(scorer = unname(methods[mc]), endpoint = ep, stratum = grp,
                 n = nrow(ds), events = sum(ds$event),
                 HR = s$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"], conf.low = s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"],
                 conf.high = s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], p = s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"])
    }))
  }))))

cat("\n=== Within-stratum continuous-score Cox (HR per 1 SD; NA = too few events) ===\n")
within_strat %>%
  dplyr::transmute(scorer, endpoint, stratum, n, events,
                   HR = round(HR, 2),
                   CI = ifelse(is.na(HR), "-", sprintf("%.2f-%.2f", conf.low, conf.high)),
                   p  = ifelse(is.na(p), "-", as.character(signif(p, 3)))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(scorer, endpoint, stratum) %>% as_tibble() %>% print(n = Inf)

# save within-stratum (LCT / NLCT) continuous-score Cox for the supplementary
write.csv(within_strat, "results/surv_within_lct_cox.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# figure: within-stratum forest for the mean scorer (primary), faceted by endpoint
ws_plot <- within_strat %>%
  dplyr::filter(scorer == unname(methods["mean"]), !is.na(HR)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = c("PFS", "OS")),
                lab = sprintf("%s  (n=%d, e=%d)", stratum, n, events))

ggplot(ws_plot, aes(x = HR, y = lab, color = stratum)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ endpoint) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("LCT" = "#B2182B", "NLCT" = "#2166AC"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "HR per 1 SD of S1-minus-S2 score (log scale)", y = NULL,
       title = "Within-stratum prognostic effect of the subtype score (mean scorer)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r surv_voom_z_weighted_km, fig.width=9, fig.height=12}
# Re-score independent cohort after TMM normalization + voom.
# Compares unweighted per-gene z scores vs subtype-DEG t-weighted z scores.
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(survival)
library(broom)

if (!exists("mat_indep")) {
  mat_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.mat.rds")
}
if (!exists("meta_indep")) {
  meta_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.meta.ss.rds")
}
if (!exists("deg_s1s2")) {
  deg_s1s2 <- readRDS("../fig4/results/res_skin_subtypes.rds")
}
if (!exists("n_sig")) {
  n_sig <- 25
}

meta_voom <- meta_indep[colnames(mat_indep), , drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(lct = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(mat_indep), rownames(meta_voom)))

dge_voom <- DGEList(counts = mat_indep)
dge_voom <- calcNormFactors(dge_voom)

# Keep the same simple expression rule as the primary analysis, then run voom.
logcpm_voom_filter <- edgeR::cpm(dge_voom, log = TRUE)
keep_voom <- rowSums(logcpm_voom_filter > 1) >= ceiling(0.10 * ncol(logcpm_voom_filter))
dge_voom <- dge_voom[keep_voom, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

design_voom <- model.matrix(~ 1, data = meta_voom)
voom_obj <- limma::voom(dge_voom, design = design_voom, plot = FALSE)
voom_expr <- voom_obj$E

genes_s1_voom <- deg_s1s2 %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0) %>%
  slice_max(t, n = n_sig) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  intersect(rownames(voom_expr))

genes_s2_voom <- deg_s1s2 %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < 0) %>%
  slice_min(t, n = n_sig) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  intersect(rownames(voom_expr))

cat("voom Subtype_1 signature genes:", length(genes_s1_voom), "\n")
cat("voom Subtype_2 signature genes:", length(genes_s2_voom), "\n")

z_by_gene <- function(x) {
  gene_mean <- rowMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  gene_sd   <- apply(x, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  z <- sweep(x, 1, gene_mean, "-")
  z <- sweep(z, 1, gene_sd, "/")
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z
}

weighted_score <- function(z_mat, genes, weights) {
  w <- abs(weights)
  w <- w / sum(w)
  as.numeric(crossprod(w, z_mat[genes, , drop = FALSE]))
}

voom_z <- z_by_gene(voom_expr)
t_lookup <- setNames(deg_s1s2$t, deg_s1s2$gene)

score_z <- data.frame(
  method     = "voom_z",
  sample     = colnames(voom_z),
  score_s1   = colMeans(voom_z[genes_s1_voom, , drop = FALSE]),
  score_s2   = colMeans(voom_z[genes_s2_voom, , drop = FALSE])
) %>%
  mutate(score_diff = score_s1 - score_s2)

score_tw <- data.frame(
  method     = "voom_t_weighted_z",
  sample     = colnames(voom_z),
  score_s1   = weighted_score(voom_z, genes_s1_voom, t_lookup[genes_s1_voom]),
  score_s2   = weighted_score(voom_z, genes_s2_voom, t_lookup[genes_s2_voom])
) %>%
  mutate(score_diff = score_s1 - score_s2)

surv_voom_scores <- bind_rows(score_z, score_tw) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_voom %>%
      select(lct, pfs_time, pfs_event, os_time, os_event) %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample"),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  mutate(
    Group_S1 = factor(
      ifelse(score_s1 >= mean(score_s1, na.rm = TRUE), "S1_High", "S1_Low"),
      levels = c("S1_High", "S1_Low")
    ),
    Group_S2 = factor(
      ifelse(score_s2 >= mean(score_s2, na.rm = TRUE), "S2_High", "S2_Low"),
      levels = c("S2_High", "S2_Low")
    ),
    Group_Diff = factor(
      ifelse(score_diff >= mean(score_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
             "Subtype_1_Like", "Subtype_2_Like"),
      levels = c("Subtype_1_Like", "Subtype_2_Like")
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("voom z-score group counts:\n")
surv_voom_scores %>%
  filter(method == "voom_z") %>%
  select(lct, Group_S1, Group_S2, Group_Diff) %>%
  { list(
      S1   = table(.$lct, .$Group_S1),
      S2   = table(.$lct, .$Group_S2),
      Diff = table(.$lct, .$Group_Diff)
    ) } %>%
  print()

cat("voom t-weighted z-score group counts:\n")
surv_voom_scores %>%
  filter(method == "voom_t_weighted_z") %>%
  select(lct, Group_S1, Group_S2, Group_Diff) %>%
  { list(
      S1   = table(.$lct, .$Group_S1),
      S2   = table(.$lct, .$Group_S2),
      Diff = table(.$lct, .$Group_Diff)
    ) } %>%
  print()

km_theme_voom <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 9)
  )

logrank_p_voom <- function(formula, data) {
  sd <- survdiff(formula, data = data)
  pchisq(sd$chisq, df = length(sd$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

make_km_voom <- function(formula, data, title, col_map) {
  fit  <- survfit(formula, data = data)
  pval <- logrank_p_voom(formula, data)
  td <- broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    mutate(strata = sub("^[^=]+=", "", strata))

  ggplot(td, aes(x = time, y = estimate, color = strata)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = td %>% filter(n.censor > 0),
               aes(x = time, y = estimate, color = strata),
               shape = 3, size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = col_map) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf,
             label = sprintf("p = %s", signif(pval, 2)),
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.0) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Time", y = "Survival probability") +
    km_theme_voom
}

cm_s1   <- c("S1_High" = "#B2182B", "S1_Low" = "grey65")
cm_s2   <- c("S2_High" = "#2166AC", "S2_Low" = "grey65")
cm_diff <- c("Subtype_1_Like" = "#B2182B", "Subtype_2_Like" = "#2166AC")

build_voom_km_row <- function(df, method_label) {
  list(
    pfs_s1   = make_km_voom(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ Group_S1, df,
                            paste0("PFS ", method_label, ": Subtype 1 score"), cm_s1),
    pfs_s2   = make_km_voom(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ Group_S2, df,
                            paste0("PFS ", method_label, ": Subtype 2 score"), cm_s2),
    pfs_diff = make_km_voom(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ Group_Diff, df,
                            paste0("PFS ", method_label, ": S1 vs S2"), cm_diff),
    os_s1    = make_km_voom(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ Group_S1, df,
                            paste0("OS ", method_label, ": Subtype 1 score"), cm_s1),
    os_s2    = make_km_voom(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ Group_S2, df,
                            paste0("OS ", method_label, ": Subtype 2 score"), cm_s2),
    os_diff  = make_km_voom(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ Group_Diff, df,
                            paste0("OS ", method_label, ": S1 vs S2"), cm_diff)
  )
}

km_z <- surv_voom_scores %>%
  filter(method == "voom_z") %>%
  build_voom_km_row("z")

km_tw <- surv_voom_scores %>%
  filter(method == "voom_t_weighted_z") %>%
  build_voom_km_row("t-weighted z")

p_voom_km_grid <-
  (km_z$pfs_s1  | km_z$pfs_s2  | km_z$pfs_diff) /
  (km_z$os_s1   | km_z$os_s2   | km_z$os_diff)  /
  (km_tw$pfs_s1 | km_tw$pfs_s2 | km_tw$pfs_diff) /
  (km_tw$os_s1  | km_tw$os_s2  | km_tw$os_diff)

print(p_voom_km_grid)

dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave("figs/surv_voom_z_weighted_km_curves.pdf", plot = p_voom_km_grid,
       width = 9, height = 12, useDingbats = FALSE)
```

```{r surv_voom_ngenes_sensitivity, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
# Sensitivity analysis: vary signature size and summarize prognostic signal.
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(survival)

if (!exists("mat_indep")) {
  mat_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.mat.rds")
}
if (!exists("meta_indep")) {
  meta_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.meta.ss.rds")
}
if (!exists("deg_s1s2")) {
  deg_s1s2 <- readRDS("../fig4/results/res_skin_subtypes.rds")
}

meta_ng <- meta_indep[colnames(mat_indep), , drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(lct = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(mat_indep), rownames(meta_ng)))

if (!exists("voom_z")) {
  dge_ng <- DGEList(counts = mat_indep)
  dge_ng <- calcNormFactors(dge_ng)
  logcpm_ng_filter <- edgeR::cpm(dge_ng, log = TRUE)
  keep_ng <- rowSums(logcpm_ng_filter > 1) >= ceiling(0.10 * ncol(logcpm_ng_filter))
  dge_ng <- dge_ng[keep_ng, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

  voom_ng <- limma::voom(dge_ng, design = model.matrix(~ 1, data = meta_ng), plot = FALSE)
  voom_expr_ng <- voom_ng$E

  gene_mean_ng <- rowMeans(voom_expr_ng, na.rm = TRUE)
  gene_sd_ng <- apply(voom_expr_ng, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  voom_z <- sweep(voom_expr_ng, 1, gene_mean_ng, "-")
  voom_z <- sweep(voom_z, 1, gene_sd_ng, "/")
  voom_z[!is.finite(voom_z)] <- 0
}

t_lookup_ng <- setNames(deg_s1s2$t, deg_s1s2$gene)
n_vals <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100)

make_weighted_score_ng <- function(z_mat, genes, weights) {
  w <- abs(weights)
  w <- w / sum(w)
  as.numeric(crossprod(w, z_mat[genes, , drop = FALSE]))
}

score_for_n <- function(n, method) {
  genes_s1_n <- deg_s1s2 %>%
    filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0) %>%
    slice_max(t, n = n) %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    intersect(rownames(voom_z))

  genes_s2_n <- deg_s1s2 %>%
    filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < 0) %>%
    slice_min(t, n = n) %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    intersect(rownames(voom_z))

  if (method == "voom_z") {
    score_s1_n <- colMeans(voom_z[genes_s1_n, , drop = FALSE])
    score_s2_n <- colMeans(voom_z[genes_s2_n, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    score_s1_n <- make_weighted_score_ng(voom_z, genes_s1_n, t_lookup_ng[genes_s1_n])
    score_s2_n <- make_weighted_score_ng(voom_z, genes_s2_n, t_lookup_ng[genes_s2_n])
  }

  data.frame(
    n_genes   = n,
    method    = method,
    sample    = colnames(voom_z),
    score_s1  = score_s1_n,
    score_s2  = score_s2_n,
    n_s1_used = length(genes_s1_n),
    n_s2_used = length(genes_s2_n)
  ) %>%
    mutate(score_diff = score_s1 - score_s2)
}

score_ng <- bind_rows(lapply(n_vals, function(n) {
  bind_rows(
    score_for_n(n, "voom_z"),
    score_for_n(n, "voom_t_weighted_z")
  )
})) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_ng %>%
      select(lct, pfs_time, pfs_event, os_time, os_event) %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample"),
    by = "sample"
  )

cat("Genes retained per requested signature size:\n")
score_ng %>%
  distinct(method, n_genes, n_s1_used, n_s2_used) %>%
  arrange(method, n_genes) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cox_summary_ng <- function(df, score_var, endpoint) {
  time_var <- ifelse(endpoint == "PFS", "pfs_time", "os_time")
  event_var <- ifelse(endpoint == "PFS", "pfs_event", "os_event")
  dat <- df %>%
    transmute(
      time  = .data[[time_var]],
      event = .data[[event_var]],
      score = as.numeric(scale(.data[[score_var]]))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(event), !is.na(score))

  fit <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ score, data = dat)
  fit_sum <- summary(fit)

  data.frame(
    endpoint  = endpoint,
    metric    = score_var,
    test      = "Continuous Cox",
    estimate  = unname(fit_sum$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]),
    conf.low  = unname(fit_sum$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]),
    conf.high = unname(fit_sum$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]),
    p.value   = unname(fit_sum$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]),
    c_index   = unname(fit_sum$concordance[1])
  )
}

logrank_summary_ng <- function(df, score_var, endpoint) {
  time_var <- ifelse(endpoint == "PFS", "pfs_time", "os_time")
  event_var <- ifelse(endpoint == "PFS", "pfs_event", "os_event")
  dat <- df %>%
    transmute(
      time  = .data[[time_var]],
      event = .data[[event_var]],
      group = ifelse(.data[[score_var]] >= mean(.data[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     "High", "Low")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(event), !is.na(group)) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("High", "Low")))

  sd <- survdiff(Surv(time, event) ~ group, data = dat)

  data.frame(
    endpoint  = endpoint,
    metric    = score_var,
    test      = "Mean-cut logrank",
    estimate  = NA_real_,
    conf.low  = NA_real_,
    conf.high = NA_real_,
    p.value   = pchisq(sd$chisq, df = length(sd$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE),
    c_index   = NA_real_
  )
}

ng_results <- score_ng %>%
  group_by(method, n_genes) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(lapply(c("score_s1", "score_s2", "score_diff"), function(score_var) {
    bind_rows(
      cox_summary_ng(.x, score_var, "PFS"),
      cox_summary_ng(.x, score_var, "OS"),
      logrank_summary_ng(.x, score_var, "PFS"),
      logrank_summary_ng(.x, score_var, "OS")
    )
  }))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric,
                    levels = c("score_s1", "score_s2", "score_diff"),
                    labels = c("Subtype 1 score", "Subtype 2 score", "S1 - S2")),
    method = factor(method,
                    levels = c("voom_z", "voom_t_weighted_z"),
                    labels = c("voom z", "voom t-weighted z")),
    endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = c("PFS", "OS")),
    test = factor(test, levels = c("Continuous Cox", "Mean-cut logrank")),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(pmax(p.value, .Machine$double.xmin))
  )

print(ng_results %>%
        select(method, n_genes, endpoint, metric, test, p.value, c_index) %>%
        arrange(method, endpoint, metric, test, n_genes) %>%
        as_tibble(),
      n = Inf)

p_ng_p <- ggplot(ng_results,
                 aes(x = n_genes, y = neg_log10_p,
                     color = metric, linetype = endpoint)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = "grey55",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_grid(test ~ method) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = n_vals) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Subtype 1 score" = "#B2182B",
                                "Subtype 2 score" = "#2166AC",
                                "S1 - S2" = "grey20")) +
  labs(x = "Genes per subtype signature",
       y = "-log10(p)",
       color = NULL,
       linetype = NULL,
       title = "Prognostic signal across signature sizes") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_ng_c <- ng_results %>%
  filter(test == "Continuous Cox") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_genes, y = c_index,
             color = metric, linetype = endpoint)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "grey55",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = n_vals) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Subtype 1 score" = "#B2182B",
                                "Subtype 2 score" = "#2166AC",
                                "S1 - S2" = "grey20")) +
  labs(x = "Genes per subtype signature",
       y = "C-index",
       color = NULL,
       linetype = NULL,
       title = "Continuous Cox discrimination across signature sizes") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_ng_sensitivity <- p_ng_p / p_ng_c
print(p_ng_sensitivity)

dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave("figs/surv_voom_ngenes_sensitivity.pdf", plot = p_ng_sensitivity,
       width = 11, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)

write.csv(ng_results, "figs/surv_voom_ngenes_sensitivity.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r surv_gene_expression_os_cox, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# Gene-wise Cox models of OS in the independent cohort.
# Right-censored samples contribute information until censoring, then leave the
# risk set automatically through Surv(os_time, os_event).
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(survival)

if (!exists("mat_indep")) {
  mat_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.mat.rds")
}
if (!exists("meta_indep")) {
  meta_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.meta.ss.rds")
}

meta_os <- meta_indep[colnames(mat_indep), , drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(lct = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(mat_indep), rownames(meta_os)))

if (!exists("voom_expr")) {
  dge_os <- DGEList(counts = mat_indep)
  dge_os <- calcNormFactors(dge_os)
  logcpm_os_filter <- edgeR::cpm(dge_os, log = TRUE)
  keep_os <- rowSums(logcpm_os_filter > 1) >= ceiling(0.10 * ncol(logcpm_os_filter))
  dge_os <- dge_os[keep_os, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  voom_os <- limma::voom(dge_os, design = model.matrix(~ 1, data = meta_os), plot = FALSE)
  voom_expr_os <- voom_os$E
} else {
  voom_expr_os <- voom_expr
}

os_df_base <- meta_os %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  select(sample, os_time, os_event, lct) %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event))

voom_expr_os <- voom_expr_os[, os_df_base$sample, drop = FALSE]

cat("OS gene-wise Cox screen:\n")
cat("Samples:", nrow(os_df_base), "\n")
cat("OS events:", sum(os_df_base$os_event == 1), "\n")
cat("Genes tested:", nrow(voom_expr_os), "\n")
cat("LCT status:\n"); print(table(os_df_base$lct))

fit_gene_os <- function(expr, gene, adjust_lct = FALSE) {
  dat <- os_df_base %>%
    mutate(expr_z = as.numeric(scale(expr)))

  if (sd(dat$expr_z, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || all(is.na(dat$expr_z))) {
    return(data.frame(
      gene = gene,
      model = ifelse(adjust_lct, "Expression + LCT", "Expression only"),
      logHR = NA_real_,
      HR = NA_real_,
      conf.low = NA_real_,
      conf.high = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      c_index = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  form <- if (adjust_lct) {
    Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ expr_z + lct
  } else {
    Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ expr_z
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    coxph(form, data = dat),
    warning = function(w) suppressWarnings(coxph(form, data = dat)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit) || !"expr_z" %in% rownames(summary(fit)$coefficients)) {
    return(data.frame(
      gene = gene,
      model = ifelse(adjust_lct, "Expression + LCT", "Expression only"),
      logHR = NA_real_,
      HR = NA_real_,
      conf.low = NA_real_,
      conf.high = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      c_index = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  fit_sum <- summary(fit)

  data.frame(
    gene = gene,
    model = ifelse(adjust_lct, "Expression + LCT", "Expression only"),
    logHR = unname(fit_sum$coefficients["expr_z", "coef"]),
    HR = unname(fit_sum$conf.int["expr_z", "exp(coef)"]),
    conf.low = unname(fit_sum$conf.int["expr_z", "lower .95"]),
    conf.high = unname(fit_sum$conf.int["expr_z", "upper .95"]),
    p.value = unname(fit_sum$coefficients["expr_z", "Pr(>|z|)"]),
    c_index = unname(fit_sum$concordance[1])
  )
}

cox_gene_unadj <- bind_rows(lapply(rownames(voom_expr_os), function(gene) {
  fit_gene_os(voom_expr_os[gene, ], gene, adjust_lct = FALSE)
}))

cox_gene_lct <- bind_rows(lapply(rownames(voom_expr_os), function(gene) {
  fit_gene_os(voom_expr_os[gene, ], gene, adjust_lct = TRUE)
}))

cox_gene_os <- bind_rows(cox_gene_unadj, cox_gene_lct) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(adj.P.Val = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = c("Expression only", "Expression + LCT")),
    direction = case_when(
      is.na(p.value) ~ "Not fit",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logHR > 0 ~ "Higher expression = worse OS",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logHR < 0 ~ "Higher expression = better OS",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    direction = factor(direction,
                       levels = c("Higher expression = worse OS",
                                  "Higher expression = better OS",
                                  "NS", "Not fit"))
  )

cat("FDR < 0.05 counts:\n")
cox_gene_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(adj.P.Val)) %>%
  count(model, direction) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cat("Top unadjusted OS genes:\n")
cox_gene_os %>%
  filter(model == "Expression only") %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  select(gene, logHR, HR, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, adj.P.Val, c_index) %>%
  head(25) %>%
  print(n = 25)

cat("Top LCT-adjusted OS genes:\n")
cox_gene_os %>%
  filter(model == "Expression + LCT") %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  select(gene, logHR, HR, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, adj.P.Val, c_index) %>%
  head(25) %>%
  print(n = 25)

label_genes_os <- cox_gene_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  slice_min(p.value, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

cox_gene_cols <- c(
  "Higher expression = worse OS" = "#B2182B",
  "Higher expression = better OS" = "#2166AC",
  "NS" = "grey75",
  "Not fit" = "grey40"
)

p_gene_os_volcano <- cox_gene_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value), is.finite(logHR)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logHR, y = -log10(p.value), color = direction)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(size = 1.1, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_genes_os,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 2.6,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.25,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cox_gene_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene-wise Cox models for OS in independent cohort",
    subtitle = "Expression terms are per-gene z-scored voom values; censored samples handled by Cox risk sets",
    x = "log hazard ratio per 1 SD expression",
    y = "-log10(p)",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_gene_os_volcano)

top_forest_os <- cox_gene_os %>%
  filter(model == "Expression only", !is.na(p.value)) %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = rev(gene)))

p_gene_os_forest <- ggplot(top_forest_os,
                           aes(x = HR, y = gene,
                               xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high,
                               color = logHR > 0)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_errorbar(orientation = "y", width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#2166AC", "TRUE" = "#B2182B"),
                     labels = c("Better OS", "Worse OS"),
                     name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Top OS-associated genes",
    subtitle = "Expression-only Cox model",
    x = "Hazard ratio per 1 SD expression",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_gene_os_forest)

dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(cox_gene_os, "figs/surv_gene_expression_os_cox.csv", row.names = FALSE)
ggsave("figs/surv_gene_expression_os_cox_volcano.pdf", plot = p_gene_os_volcano,
       width = 10, height = 6.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggsave("figs/surv_gene_expression_os_cox_forest.pdf", plot = p_gene_os_forest,
       width = 5.5, height = 6.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
```

```{r surv_tcell_fraction_vs_outcome, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
# Marker-based estimate of T-cell abundance in each independent bulk sample.
# This is a relative marker fraction, not a literal deconvolved cell percentage.
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(survival)

if (!exists("mat_indep")) {
  mat_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.mat.rds")
}
if (!exists("meta_indep")) {
  meta_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.meta.ss.rds")
}

meta_tcell <- meta_indep[colnames(mat_indep), , drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(lct = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(mat_indep), rownames(meta_tcell)))

if (!exists("voom_expr")) {
  dge_tcell <- DGEList(counts = mat_indep)
  dge_tcell <- calcNormFactors(dge_tcell)
  logcpm_tcell_filter <- edgeR::cpm(dge_tcell, log = TRUE)
  keep_tcell <- rowSums(logcpm_tcell_filter > 1) >= ceiling(0.10 * ncol(logcpm_tcell_filter))
  dge_tcell <- dge_tcell[keep_tcell, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  voom_tcell <- limma::voom(dge_tcell, design = model.matrix(~ 1, data = meta_tcell), plot = FALSE)
  expr_tcell <- voom_tcell$E
} else {
  expr_tcell <- voom_expr
}

lineage_markers <- list(
  T_cell = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G", "TRAC", "TRBC1", "TRBC2",
             "CD2", "CD5", "CD247", "LCK", "LAT"),
  B_cell = c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B", "CD19", "BANK1", "CD22"),
  Myeloid = c("LYZ", "LST1", "AIF1", "CD68", "FCGR3A", "CSF1R"),
  Keratinocyte = c("KRT5", "KRT14", "KRT1", "KRT10", "KRTDAP", "DSG1"),
  Fibroblast = c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "DCN", "LUM", "COL3A1", "PDGFRA"),
  Endothelial = c("PECAM1", "VWF", "KDR", "ENG", "EMCN", "CLDN5")
)

lineage_markers_present <- lapply(lineage_markers, intersect, y = rownames(expr_tcell))
cat("Lineage marker genes retained:\n")
print(sapply(lineage_markers_present, length))

marker_module_expr <- sapply(names(lineage_markers_present), function(nm) {
  genes <- lineage_markers_present[[nm]]
  if (length(genes) == 0) {
    rep(NA_real_, ncol(expr_tcell))
  } else {
    colMeans(2^expr_tcell[genes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
})
rownames(marker_module_expr) <- colnames(expr_tcell)

tcell_fraction_df <- as.data.frame(marker_module_expr) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  mutate(
    marker_total = rowSums(across(all_of(names(lineage_markers_present))), na.rm = TRUE),
    tcell_fraction = T_cell / marker_total,
    tcell_percent = 100 * tcell_fraction
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_tcell %>%
      select(lct, pfs_time, pfs_event, os_time, os_event) %>%
      rownames_to_column("sample"),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pfs_status = factor(ifelse(pfs_event == 1, "Event", "Censored"),
                        levels = c("Event", "Censored")),
    pfs_status = factor(ifelse(pfs_event == 1, "Event", "Censored"),
                       levels = c("Event", "Censored"))
  )

cat("Estimated T-cell marker percent summary:\n")
tcell_fraction_df %>%
  group_by(lct) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_tcell_percent = median(tcell_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tcell_percent = mean(tcell_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tcell_percent = sd(tcell_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()

cox_tcell <- function(endpoint) {
  time_var <- ifelse(endpoint == "PFS", "pfs_time", "os_time")
  event_var <- ifelse(endpoint == "PFS", "pfs_event", "os_event")
  dat <- tcell_fraction_df %>%
    transmute(
      time = .data[[time_var]],
      event = .data[[event_var]],
      tcell_percent_z = as.numeric(scale(tcell_percent))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(event), !is.na(tcell_percent_z))

  fit <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ tcell_percent_z, data = dat)
  fit_sum <- summary(fit)

  data.frame(
    endpoint = endpoint,
    HR_per_1sd = unname(fit_sum$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]),
    conf.low = unname(fit_sum$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]),
    conf.high = unname(fit_sum$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]),
    p.value = unname(fit_sum$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]),
    c_index = unname(fit_sum$concordance[1])
  )
}

tcell_cox_results <- bind_rows(cox_tcell("PFS"), cox_tcell("OS"))
cat("Cox models for estimated T-cell marker percent:\n")
print(tcell_cox_results)

lct_cols <- c("NLCT" = "#4393C3", "LCT" = "#B2182B")

make_tcell_outcome_plot <- function(y_var, status_var, y_lab, title) {
  ggplot(tcell_fraction_df,
         aes(x = tcell_percent, y = .data[[y_var]],
             color = lct, shape = .data[[status_var]])) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0.35) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(x = tcell_percent, y = .data[[y_var]], color = lct, group = lct),
      method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.15,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = lct_cols, name = "LCT") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Event" = 16, "Censored" = 1), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "Estimated T-cell marker percent",
         y = y_lab,
         title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

p_tcell_pfs <- make_tcell_outcome_plot(
  "pfs_time", "pfs_status", "PFS time",
  "Estimated T-cell abundance vs PFS"
)

p_tcell_os <- make_tcell_outcome_plot(
  "pfs_time", "pfs_status", "PFS time",
  "Estimated T-cell abundance vs OS"
)

p_tcell_outcome <- p_tcell_pfs / p_tcell_os
print(p_tcell_outcome)

p_tcell_lct <- ggplot(tcell_fraction_df, aes(x = lct, y = tcell_percent, fill = lct)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.14, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "grey30") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1, alpha = 0.6, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lct_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimated T-cell marker percent",
       title = "Estimated T-cell abundance by LCT status") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_tcell_lct)

dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(tcell_fraction_df, "figs/surv_estimated_tcell_fraction.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tcell_cox_results, "figs/surv_estimated_tcell_fraction_cox.csv", row.names = FALSE)
ggsave("figs/surv_estimated_tcell_fraction_vs_outcome.pdf", plot = p_tcell_outcome,
       width = 6, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggsave("figs/surv_estimated_tcell_fraction_lct_violin.pdf", plot = p_tcell_lct,
       width = 3.5, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)
```
