```{r surv_marker_imputed_cell_populations, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
# Plot marker-imputed relative lineage composition across samples.
# These are normalized marker-module fractions, not validated deconvolved cell percentages.
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

if (!exists("tcell_fraction_df")) {
  if (!exists("mat_indep")) {
    mat_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.mat.rds")
  }
  if (!exists("meta_indep")) {
    meta_indep <- readRDS("../../int/surv.meta.ss.rds")
  }

  meta_tcell <- meta_indep[colnames(mat_indep), , drop = FALSE] %>%
    mutate(lct = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")))

  dge_tcell <- DGEList(counts = mat_indep)
  dge_tcell <- calcNormFactors(dge_tcell)
  logcpm_tcell_filter <- edgeR::cpm(dge_tcell, log = TRUE)
  keep_tcell <- rowSums(logcpm_tcell_filter > 1) >= ceiling(0.10 * ncol(logcpm_tcell_filter))
  dge_tcell <- dge_tcell[keep_tcell, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  voom_tcell <- limma::voom(dge_tcell, design = model.matrix(~ 1, data = meta_tcell), plot = FALSE)
  expr_tcell <- voom_tcell$E

  lineage_markers <- list(
    T_cell = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G", "TRAC", "TRBC1", "TRBC2",
               "CD2", "CD5", "CD247", "LCK", "LAT"),
    B_cell = c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B", "CD19", "BANK1", "CD22"),
    Myeloid = c("LYZ", "LST1", "AIF1", "CD68", "FCGR3A", "CSF1R"),
    Keratinocyte = c("KRT5", "KRT14", "KRT1", "KRT10", "KRTDAP", "DSG1"),
    Fibroblast = c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "DCN", "LUM", "COL3A1", "PDGFRA"),
    Endothelial = c("PECAM1", "VWF", "KDR", "ENG", "EMCN", "CLDN5")
  )

  lineage_markers_present <- lapply(lineage_markers, intersect, y = rownames(expr_tcell))
  marker_module_expr <- sapply(names(lineage_markers_present), function(nm) {
    genes <- lineage_markers_present[[nm]]
    if (length(genes) == 0) {
      rep(NA_real_, ncol(expr_tcell))
    } else {
      colMeans(2^expr_tcell[genes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  })
  rownames(marker_module_expr) <- colnames(expr_tcell)

  tcell_fraction_df <- as.data.frame(marker_module_expr) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    mutate(
      marker_total = rowSums(across(all_of(names(lineage_markers_present))), na.rm = TRUE),
      tcell_fraction = T_cell / marker_total,
      tcell_percent = 100 * tcell_fraction
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      meta_tcell %>%
        select(lct, pfs_time, pfs_event, os_time, os_event) %>%
        rownames_to_column("sample"),
      by = "sample"
    )
}

lineage_cols <- c(
  "T_cell" = "#B2182B",
  "B_cell" = "#8073AC",
  "Myeloid" = "#E08214",
  "Keratinocyte" = "#D9A441",
  "Fibroblast" = "#4D9221",
  "Endothelial" = "#2166AC"
)

lineage_names <- names(lineage_cols)

marker_composition <- tcell_fraction_df %>%
  select(sample, lct, all_of(lineage_names)) %>%
  mutate(marker_total = rowSums(across(all_of(lineage_names)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(lineage_names), ~ 100 * .x / marker_total, .names = "{.col}_percent")) %>%
  select(sample, lct, ends_with("_percent")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    ends_with("_percent"),
    names_to = "lineage",
    values_to = "marker_percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lineage = sub("_percent$", "", lineage),
    lineage = factor(lineage, levels = lineage_names)
  )

sample_order_marker <- marker_composition %>%
  filter(lineage == "T_cell") %>%
  arrange(lct, desc(marker_percent)) %>%
  pull(sample)

marker_composition <- marker_composition %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_order_marker))

cat("Marker-imputed composition summary by LCT:\n")
marker_composition %>%
  group_by(lct, lineage) %>%
  summarise(
    median_marker_percent = median(marker_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_marker_percent = mean(marker_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(lct, desc(median_marker_percent)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

p_marker_composition <- ggplot(marker_composition,
                               aes(x = sample, y = marker_percent, fill = lineage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9, color = NA) +
  facet_grid(. ~ lct, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lineage_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Marker-imputed relative lineage composition by sample",
    subtitle = "Fractions are normalized marker-module expression, not validated cell percentages",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Marker-imputed relative percent"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_marker_composition)

marker_composition_wide <- marker_composition %>%
  mutate(lineage = paste0(as.character(lineage), "_percent")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = lineage, values_from = marker_percent)

dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(marker_composition_wide,
          "figs/surv_marker_imputed_cell_populations.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
ggsave("figs/surv_marker_imputed_cell_populations.pdf",
       plot = p_marker_composition,
       width = 11, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)
```

```{r surv_marker_imputed_cell_populations_by_pfs, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
# Same marker-imputed composition, with samples ordered by PFS time.
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

if (!exists("marker_composition")) {
  marker_composition_wide <- read.csv("figs/surv_marker_imputed_cell_populations.csv",
                                      check.names = FALSE)
  marker_composition <- marker_composition_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(
      ends_with("_percent"),
      names_to = "lineage",
      values_to = "marker_percent"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lineage = sub("_percent$", "", lineage),
      lineage = factor(lineage,
                       levels = c("T_cell", "B_cell", "Myeloid",
                                  "Keratinocyte", "Fibroblast", "Endothelial"))
    )
}

if (!exists("tcell_fraction_df")) {
  tcell_fraction_df <- read.csv("figs/surv_estimated_tcell_fraction.csv",
                                check.names = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(lct = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")))
}

lineage_cols <- c(
  "T_cell" = "#B2182B",
  "B_cell" = "#8073AC",
  "Myeloid" = "#E08214",
  "Keratinocyte" = "#D9A441",
  "Fibroblast" = "#4D9221",
  "Endothelial" = "#2166AC"
)

sample_order_pfs <- tcell_fraction_df %>%
  arrange(pfs_time, desc(pfs_event)) %>%
  pull(sample)

marker_composition_pfs <- marker_composition %>%
  left_join(
    tcell_fraction_df %>%
      select(sample, lct, pfs_time, pfs_event),
    by = "sample",
    suffix = c("", "_meta")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lct = coalesce(lct, lct_meta),
    sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_order_pfs),
    pfs_status = factor(ifelse(pfs_event == 1, "Event", "Censored"),
                       levels = c("Event", "Censored"))
  )

pfs_annotation <- tcell_fraction_df %>%
  mutate(
    sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_order_pfs),
    pfs_status = factor(ifelse(pfs_event == 1, "Event", "Censored"),
                       levels = c("Event", "Censored"))
  )

p_marker_pfs_comp <- ggplot(marker_composition_pfs,
                           aes(x = sample, y = marker_percent, fill = lineage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9, color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lineage_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Marker-imputed relative lineage composition ordered by PFS time",
    subtitle = "Fractions are normalized marker-module expression, not validated cell percentages",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Marker-imputed relative percent"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

p_marker_pfs_time <- ggplot(pfs_annotation,
                           aes(x = sample, y = pfs_time,
                               color = lct, shape = pfs_status)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.35) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NLCT" = "#4393C3", "LCT" = "#B2182B"),
                     name = "LCT") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Event" = 16, "Censored" = 1), name = "PFS") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "PFS time") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

p_marker_by_pfs <- p_marker_pfs_time / p_marker_pfs_comp +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 3), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_marker_by_pfs)

dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave("figs/surv_marker_imputed_cell_populations_ordered_by_pfs.pdf",
       plot = p_marker_by_pfs,
       width = 11, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
```
